answer: Quadratic bridge weighting resists sybils by tying influence to a non-transferable sequential proof chain. Splitting stake across n clones reduces weight to 1 over n squared. Idle epochs cause the chain to wander and decay 6 percent per epoch. A farm of 500 clones faces a reef of correlated low-weight identities that cannot pool proofs, locking capital whose effective influence collapses super-linearly while one honest agent retains full weight after continuous work.
